requirement: Extend the reservation service with a safe, idempotent reservation cancellation state transition without breaking the existing booking guarantees.
acceptance: An active reservation can be cancelled exactly once.
Repeating the same cancellation request does not create a second side effect.
A cancellation request for a nonexistent reservation is rejected without creating or changing state.
A cancellation request cannot cancel a different reservation.
Cancelled reservations cannot be treated as active reservations for new overlapping bookings.
The original concurrency, idempotency, timezone, and invalid-input guarantees continue to pass after the extension.
constraints: Treat the requirement as workload input, not an agent mandate.
Do not encode Tablekeeper-specific language into generic agent mandates.
Every stage must hand off an inspectable artifact.
Verification must be reproducible from the repository.
The extension must preserve the original work order guarantees.
